nodes.name: Canonical Ownership.md
nodes.summary: Hard invariant constraint (CON-003) requiring that every implementation concept in dev_graph has exactly one canonical node with no duplicates, ensuring unambiguous retrieval and clean graph traversal for context pack assembly.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph constraint node with 18 structured sections including Constraint Expression, Severity (blocking), Verification, Enforcement Rules, and Relationships. Referenced by Dev Graph Governance, Context Pack Assembly Rules, and Admissibility Checks.

nodes.name: Frontmatter Required.md
nodes.summary: Hard invariant constraint (CON-002) mandating that every dev_graph content node (excluding structural files) must carry valid YAML frontmatter with all universal schema fields, ensuring Dataview queryability, MCP filterability, and Neo4j/Postgres export readiness.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the exact YAML predicate expression for frontmatter completeness and references per-session and weekly lint verification mechanisms including the Dev Graph Dashboard Dataview query.

nodes.name: No Wiki Mutation.md
nodes.summary: Foundational hard boundary constraint (CON-001) prohibiting all Claude Code dev_graph sessions from modifying any files in wiki/** or raw/**, preserving the integrity of the mature wiki knowledge graph and enforcing strict two-graph architectural separation.
nodes.languageNotes: Severity is Error (blocking) with no exceptions. Verification relies on pre-commit git diff checks and MCP operation audits. This is the foundational constraint loaded at every dev_graph session via the CLAUDE.md import chain.
